node.statement: Route F PRH finish: let A:l-infinity(k)->l-infinity(n) and M:l-infinity(n)->l-infinity(k) be positive unital maps and let Q be row-stochastic; if K >= 1, 0 <= eta <= min{(24*K)^(-1),1}, ||Q-AM||_{infinity->infinity} <= K*eta, and ||MA-I||_{infinity->infinity} <= 3*K*eta/(1-3*K*eta), then there is a stochastic idempotent E with ||Q-E||_{infinity->infinity} <= (K+4*sqrt(2*K))*sqrt(eta).
